speaker: Doctor
text: The X-ray findings of hyperinflated lungs and flattened diaphragms are classic signs of emphysema. Given your 20-year smoking history, do you notice that your breathlessness improves significantly when you lean forward or use a fan to blow air on your face?

speaker: Patient
text: No, leaning forward or using a fan doesn't seem to make the shortness of breath any better for me. I just feel generally tight in my chest and struggle to catch my breath even during light tasks like walking to the store.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely Emphysema.
